deployments_detail.use: ai.carrefour, a global AI platform launched first in Spain to make AI accessible across HR, customer experience and internal processes (built on the earlier uno.ia super-agent) [Google Gemini 2.0]
deployments_detail.value: launch event connected 3,000+ employees in Spain

deployments_detail.use: Smart-store rollout using Captana AI micro-cameras and EdgeSense smart shelves/rails to detect out-of-stocks, price discrepancies and planogram errors in real time across all French hyper/supermarkets [VusionGroup (Captana AI, EdgeSense)]
deployments_detail.value: millions of smart labels; all French stores by 2030

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven dynamic markdown / smart pricing of perishable fresh products to reduce food waste, rolled out to all Carrefour Argentina stores [Wasteless]
deployments_detail.value: 45% reduction in markdown costs in first year; 640 stores

deployments_detail.use: Machine-learning demand forecasting for the bakery-pastry department to cut food waste, deployed across French supermarkets after piloting in 200+ stores [Artefact]
deployments_detail.value: ~100 tons of pastries saved from waste in 5 months (2021)

deployments_detail.use: Three OpenAI/ChatGPT-based solutions: "Hopla" shopping-advice chatbot on carrefour.fr, AI-generated product descriptions, and AI purchase assistance (own press release, 2023)
Industrial partnership with Vusion for IoT + AI smart-shelf/electronic-label digitalization of entire French store network by 2030
AI assistance for the non-merchandise purchasing division, drafting tender/call-for-proposal documents and analyzing quotes [OpenAI (GPT-4) on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]
Group-wide generative AI employee assistant to simplify daily work and free operational time, rolled out to all staff across eight countries [Google Gemini]
AI demand forecasting and inventory optimization across stores, warehouses and e-commerce to reduce waste and overstock; deployed after an 18-month pilot [SAS (Viya), integrator Capgemini]

Hopla, a ChatGPT/GPT-4 based conversational shopping assistant on Carrefour.fr that helps customers find products by budget, dietary needs and recipes, with anti-waste suggestions [OpenAI (GPT-4) on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, integrator Bain & Company]
Generative AI enrichment of Carrefour private-label product description sheets (over 2,000 products online, extending across the catalog) [OpenAI (GPT-4) on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]

AI-powered precision marketing: four ML models (customer lifetime value, segmentation, conversion prediction, churn) built on Google Cloud AutoML to optimize online advertising at Carrefour Taiwan [Google Cloud AutoML / Google Ads]
deployments_detail.value: 2.64x higher ROAS; 40% lower cost per action

deployments_detail.use: Grocery shopping service inside ChatGPT: users plan meals, search products in natural language, filter by diet, check availability and build a basket, then finalize on carrefour.fr (first major European retailer to do so) [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]
deployments_detail.value: targets ~26 million ChatGPT users in France
